subject: Request: Exception for Payment Timing / Quarterly Invoicing - Helix Data
messages:
From: Karen Zhou <karen.zhou@helixdata.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Helix Data Finance <finance@helixdata.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Payment schedule exception request (Helix / Redwood)

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move forward. Our procurement team is requesting an alternate billing cadence for this engagement: Helix requires quarterly invoicing aligned with our fiscal quarters and Net-90 payment terms. This is our standard for vendor contracts over $250k.

We can issue a PO once terms are agreed. I attached our PO template and the SOW with the requested start date. Can Redwood accommodate quarterly invoices and Net-90 for a one-year contract? If not, what compromise would you propose?

Files attached: Helix_PO_20260815.pdf; SOW_HelixData_v2.pdf

Appreciate a quick check — our procurement lead wants to close the loop this week.

Best,
Karen Zhou
Sr. Procurement Manager
Helix Data Systems
phone: 415-555-0182


From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Karen Zhou <karen.zhou@helixdata.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment schedule exception request (Helix / Redwood)

Hi Karen — thanks for the note and the PO/SOW. Great to hear the team is ready.

Quick note to confirm I received the PO and the requested Net-90 / quarterly cadence. I need to run this through finance and our deal desk since Net-90 is an exception to our standard Net-30 terms.

Marcus (finance) and Lauren (CS lead) — looping you both in. High-level: 12-month engagement, ARR ~$420k (listed in the SOW), Helix prefers quarterly invoices and 90-day payment window. They have a PO ready. What are the finance concerns / required controls if we consider Net-90 and quarterly billing?

Marcus — I attached a draft billing schedule I put together as a possible compromise (30% upfront, then quarterly invoicing tied to milestones). If there are alternative structures that reduce risk, happy to propose to Karen.

Karen — we’ll come back with a recommended path and approvals by tomorrow.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

Attachment: billing-plan-helix.xlsx (draft)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment schedule exception request (Helix / Redwood)

Stephanie — reviewed the SOW and PO. A few items from finance:

- Net-90 materially increases DSO and credit exposure for a ~$420k deal.
- If we accept quarterly billing we should require either: (a) 30% upfront prepayment, or (b) an executed credit application + trade references + an explicit credit cap.
- We should include contract language for: late-payment interest (1.5% / month), suspension of service after 120 days, and an invoice dispute window (14 days).

Suggested compromise we can approve without exec sign-off: 30% upfront + quarterly invoices on milestones + Net-60 payment terms.

For Net-90 we need an executive approval that documents the business rationale (strategic account, reference value, expansion runway) and explicit acceptance of DSO impact. If you want Net-90 we should escalate to Rishi for deal desk/leadership approval.

I attached a quick billing-plan worksheet with cashflow impact and proposed milestone mapping.

Attachment: billing-plan-helix.xlsx

-Marcus Lin
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: ESCALATION: Helix request for Net-90 + quarterly invoicing (DL-2026-0873)

Rishi / Lauren — escalating for approval. Summary below:

- Customer: Helix Data Systems (Procurement: Karen Zhou)
- ARR / Contract value: $420,000 / 12 months (SOW attached)
- Request: Quarterly invoicing aligned to fiscal quarters + Net-90 payment terms (Helix policy for >$250k vendors)
- Current finance position (Marcus): Prefer 30% upfront + Net-60; Net-90 needs exec sign-off.
- Commercial rationale: Large, strategic account in fintech vertical; strong product fit; reference potential for two additional BU deals in H1 2027.
- Risks: Increased DSO, cashflow impact, precedence for other enterprise deals.

Asks:
1) Rishi — do you approve Net-90 for this deal subject to contract protections? If yes, please state conditions (prepayment, late fee, credit cap, PO acceptance).
2) Legal / Finance — support to add explicit suspension and late-fee language if approved.

I’ve attached the customer PO and SOW, plus Marcus’s billing worksheet. If we get sign-off today I’ll send a term summary back to Karen and request a signed DocuSign.

Thanks,
Stephanie
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ESCALATION: Helix request for Net-90 + quarterly invoicing (DL-2026-0873)

Thanks for the clear summary, Stephanie. After reviewing revenue impact and strategic value, I approve a conditional Net-90 exception for Helix with the following required controls:

- Commercial conditions: 30% upfront payment (invoice upon countersigned SOW) + remaining balance invoiced quarterly, tied to the milestones in SOW.
- Credit & legal controls: Customer to complete our credit application and provide two trade references prior to first invoice. Add explicit suspension clause (service suspension after 120 days of non-payment) and a late fee of 1.5% per month.
- Executive note: Approval is conditional on Legal updating the SOW and Finance confirming the credit application is satisfactory.

Marcus — please confirm you can operationalize the milestone invoicing and that the billing-plan worksheet lines up with the proposed schedule. Lauren — if CS sees any operational risk with the suspension clause let us know.

Once Marcus confirms I’ll sign the approval ticket and Stephanie can communicate back to the customer with next steps.

-Rishi
Head of Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Karen Zhou <karen.zhou@helixdata.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 18:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment schedule exception request (Helix / Redwood) — Approved with conditions

Hi Karen — thanks for your patience. Good news: we can accommodate quarterly invoicing and an extended payment window, conditional on a couple of items. Approved terms are below: 

- Prepayment: 30% of total contract value due upon countersigned SOW (invoice will be issued via DocuSign).
- Invoicing cadence: Remaining balance invoiced quarterly, aligned to the milestones in the SOW.
- Payment window: Net-90 for quarterly invoices.
- Credit & legal controls: Helix to complete Redwood credit application and provide two trade references prior to first invoice. We will include: (a) suspension of service after 120 days of non-payment and (b) late fee of 1.5% per month for overdue amounts.

Next steps:
1) I will send updated SOW (legal to add suspension/late-fee language) via DocuSign — please countersign the SOW and return. Link: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/Sign?envelopeId=5a1b2c
2) Helix completes the attached credit application and returns to finance@redwood.ai.
3) Once upfront payment is received and credit checks clear, we will schedule the kickoff and issue the first quarterly invoice.

Attachments: SOW_HelixData_v2.pdf (updated pending legal), billing-plan-helix.xlsx

Appreciate you working through this — happy to hop on a quick call if you want to speed the credit checks.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
phone: 650-555-0199
